securityMatrix.title: Peer Notebook Unified SOC 2 Type 1, ISO 27001:2022 & HIPAA Security Matrix
regulatoryStandards: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (2017 with 2022 revisions)
HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C)
CalAIM Payment Reform Behavioral Health Standards

controls.name: Multi-Tenant Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.implementation: Supabase PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) enforcing tenant isolation (auth.uid() = specialist_id or supervisor tenant match).

controls.name: Offline Cryptographic Token Storage & Rotation
controls.implementation: WebCrypto AES-GCM (256-bit) local encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation and mandatory rotation interval (> 72 hours).

controls.name: Immutable Audit Logging & Chain Integrity
controls.implementation: Deterministic HMAC-SHA256 signature chain per audit record. Tamper-evident logging of note creation, approvals, and credential rotations.

controls.name: End-to-End Transmission Security & API Boundary
controls.implementation: Enforced TLS 1.3 on all endpoints. Direct Brevo REST API dispatch over HTTPS (purged legacy unencrypted/vulnerable SMTP sockets).

controls.name: PHI Data Minimization & Safe Harbor Masking
controls.implementation: Synthetic UUID entity modeling. Prohibits SSN, telephone, and unredacted names from all telemetry, webhook alerts, and external payloads.

controls.name: Contingency Planning & Cold Disaster Recovery
controls.implementation: Cold site restoration runbook with verified RTO < 4h, RPO < 15m, and Dexie.js offline-first client resilience buffer (up to 168h).
